Kanae"Presumably. Truly, one never knows what will become a misfortune and what a blessing."
Cannon"...Indeed."

ウィロー"What does it mean!?"
Cannon"..."

高官"—T."
Kanae"..."
Sayo"Milady, restraint. Your right hand is one instant from delivering the correcting chop."
Kanae"Ahem. ...May we proceed, Count?"
高官"Yes. Begin."
Kanae"So, gentlemen of GHQ. Lord Ruby Sarchant, Deputy Secretary-General of the League—"
Kanae"Has just arrived in Yamato as headquarters’ plenipotentiary."
ウィロー"...Plenipotentiary!?"
Kanae"Yes. No explanation of the term required, Major General?"
ウィロー"Absurd! You cannot suddenly send us such a thing!"
Kanae"What can I say? If dissatisfied, perhaps request it of His Lordship?"
ウィロー"Request?"
Kanae"Lord Sarchant, you have Her Majesty’s credentials with you?"
高官"Naturally. Wish to inspect them, Major General Willow?"
ウィロー"..."
ウィロー"B-but is this not irregular? No word to us here, then a sudden plenipotentiary!"
ウィロー"It disrupts military command!"
Sayo"A sound argument."
Kanae"Quite."
ウィロー"...Wait in Yokohama for the present! We shall confirm with headquarters, and then—"
高官"That will not do, Major General Willow."
ウィロー"W-why?"
高官"Do you not understand?"
ウィロー"..."
高官"Do you not... understand?"
ウィロー"..."

高官"Not she alone, naturally..."

高官"Every attempt failed. Had you only learned that this was heaven’s will—that God approved the Queen’s rule."
高官"Instead you understood on a lower level. Defeat because strength was lacking... armor lacking..."
高官"Because the New Continent produces no tsurugi. That was your conclusion."

高官"So you wanted Yamato. One of the world’s foremost armor producers..."
高官"Pretend to offer it to Her Majesty, steal it for yourselves. Then rise. The fifth New Continent independence war."

高官"Yet I sympathize. You surely suffered, surely were driven into a corner."

高官"But, Willow. Rebellion still cannot be permitted."
ウィロー"Having... come this far..."

Sayo"..."
ウィロー"I will not accept it!"
